arguments.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS porn_videos (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
	porn_video_url TEXT,
	description TEXT,
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evil_list (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
	name TEXT,
	reason TEXT,
	date_added DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE);
